source.source_name: data.egov.kz — State Database of Legal Entities (ГБД ЮЛ / gbd_ul)
source.organization: Open Data Portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan (data.egov.kz), Ministry of Digital Development

transport.rate_limit: free API key required (registration); 403 'API key is required' without a key

parsing.notes: Authoritative open legal-entities register on data.egov.kz. Access via /api/v4/gbd_ul/<version>?apiKey=<key>&size=<n> — REQUIRES a FREE API key (registration on data.egov.kz); verified 403 {'error':'API key is required'} without a key. Confirm the current <version> string from the dataset page. Fields: BIN, name (RU/KZ), registration date, legal address, OKED activity, director full name. Key = BIN (12-digit). Redact director_full_name (personal data, Law on Personal Data). Russian primary; OKED activity classifier.

mapping_rules.tax_id: bin (the BIN serves as the tax id).

live_test_plan.smoke: With a free API key, GET /api/v4/gbd_ul/<version>?apiKey=...&size=3; expect legal-entity records with BIN.
live_test_plan.full: Page through gbd_ul with the API key; redact director names; join to KGD on BIN.
